# Windowpane Test

The windowpane test checks whether a dough's gluten network is developed
enough to hold gas: a small piece of dough is stretched gently between the
fingers until light shines through it. If it stretches into an even,
translucent sheet without tearing, the network is ready; if it rips early,
the dough needs more folding or kneading.^[raw/articles/the-science-of-a-good-loaf.md]

## Why it matters

- Turns an invisible property of the dough into something a baker can see.
- Works the same for an [[autolyse]] dough and a heavily kneaded one.
